scope: Offline inventory reader and image preparation only; no Fedora execution or OS qualification
observation: Old tool discovery checked only /usr/bin and file existence; it could miss admin executables in /usr/sbin or accept nonexecutables. RPM inventory has no sudo/sudo-rs package, but executable discovery is being corrected before hardening changes.
changes: Explicit /usr/bin:/usr/sbin executable search with resolved locations retained
Bounded discovery of fixed public login, sudo, sysctl and polkit configuration; record symlinks without reading their targets
